goal: Silence Tor connection failure warnings on default node configurations that do not use Tor
Avoids polluting debug.log with around 18 spurious warning and refusal notices every hour
Log an informational notice when an active onion service unexpectedly drops
agreement: Strong support with no open objections across multiple reviewers
Verified cleaner logging through testing on macOS and Debian (pinheadmz, winterrdog)
Concept approval noting that the failure log is noisy and belongs behind a category (ismaelsadeeq)
Approved after preserving failure warnings when Tor is explicitly configured (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it eliminates recurring log noise introduced in v32 on default node configurations
Default nodes without Tor repeatedly log around 18 warnings and refusal lines per hour
The impact is limited to cleaner node diagnostics and does not alter peer-to-peer behavior
